title: Using PyroModule with torch.nn.ModueList fails for nested modules
author: MartinBubel

comments.author: fritzo
comments.body: @MartinBubel this is indeed a subtle issue. Do you have a sense how prevalent slice indexing is in the main torch codebase and in user codebases?

comments.author: MartinBubel
comments.body: quick follow up to your @fritzo question above: I don't think slice-inedexing is a very common use case. Also, the line that causes the loss of the parent-module's `_.pyro_name` is necessary from a torch-context, and replacing it with the `torch.nn.ModuleList` contructor, as in this PR is not an option for general `torch`, as noted [here](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/121008#issuecomment-1985953665). I guess with the fix applied in the PR, we should be safe for `pyro` use cases.
